_charter: Guest Kalls: strangers seal forecasts on this desk under the same standards its own arms face. Every parameter here is policy, printed. The gate publishes its rejections with reasons; the operator's seal label is the only ingestion path; a guest's misses stay on the record under their login forever. RPAS 5.02/5.04: every guest is their own arm, never pooled, counts-only below the fifty-entry gate.
resolution_instrument_classes: government or intergovernmental data feeds (e.g. CISA KEV, USGS FDSN, GDACS, Federal Register, official statistical agencies)
central bank and treasury published series (e.g. ECB Data Portal, US Treasury par yield curve)
major exchange or index official settlements, named exactly
court dockets and official filings, named exactly
other named public instruments a stranger can read without an account
refused_shapes: statements whose resolution depends on this desk's own conduct
anything the mechanical gate rejects: unfalsifiable wording, missing failure condition, probability outside the 5-95 band, deadline outside the window
_note: Changing a number here changes the policy for submissions after the change is committed; it never touches a sealed row.
